limitations: Synthetic data only: no real customers, premises, tariffs, outages or bills; tariffs are fictional round numbers.
No global scheduler: time moves through events and Infra's env.advance_time, which runs no App code; time-based statuses are derived from the virtual time.
Technicians, shipments, outages, advisories, billing cycles and payment settlement happen only through Infra-applied events.
The outbound Mail adapter is invoked explicitly by the example and tests; automatic invocation belongs to the planned runner.
Business web page served by the shared Web Host (gui/); MCP remains the Agent interface.
